method: Get-NetNeighbor -IPAddress; read-only local cache query, no ping or packet intentionally sent
source_of_target: Historically reported device IP before most recent calibration; not verified as current
limitations: The empty returned list does not prove the ESP32 is disconnected, powered off, or at a different address.
An IP address alone does not verify device identity, firmware, RAM coefficients, or UART function.
The latest successful CAL capture reported WiFi suspended/radio off; later reconnect status is unknown.
